lines.text: The subagents are striking until we assign them some imaginary friends.
All those idle subagents are just protesting for better nap schedules.
Our helper crew is on a permanent coffee break until we pick a model.
A quiet workspace is nice, but waking the subagents might take a click.
The files are resting peacefully while the models figure out who is in charge.
Thirty-two pending tasks are meditating patiently in the void.
The subagent convention failed because nobody invited a model to speak.
Looks like our little helpers forgot their backstage passes again.
Missing models mean the assistants are currently wandering outside the tent.
The repository is still as a sleeping cat waiting for its favorite toy.
Fourteen files lie undisturbed while the configuration takes a breather.
A peaceful afternoon in the codebase, entirely free of moving gears.
